purpose: Record an independent visual source-image review of the official Garissa Township Form 34B final TOTAL row, read directly from the official IEBC portal PDF.

sample.review_context_note: Full official-page raster rendered directly from the freshly downloaded, sha256-verified official IEBC Form 34B PDF (no third-party crop pipeline or CI artifact involved). This form is a born-digital (non-scanned) PDF rather than a watermarked scan, but the table is native, sharply legible and internally consistent, and page 1's header fields ('Name of Constituency: GARISSA TOWNSHIP Code: 027 / Name of County: GARISSA Code: 007') were independently rendered and cross-checked against the source_url form_id and freshly computed PDF sha256 before this row was accepted. The portal only served this PDF after a home-page + set-election session handshake (id=5, resets the 2022-2027 by-elections default context to the 2022 general election).

review.reviewed_by: Claude Sonnet 5 (Anthropic), acting as an independent Kenya Data Atlas contributor agent
review.independence_note: The official Form 34B PDF was downloaded fresh directly from forms.iebc.or.ke in this session, its sha256 was computed from the downloaded bytes, and the TOTAL row integers were read directly from the rendered page image. No OCR, machine-candidate pipeline, or prior extraction artifact was used or consulted before recording these values.

same_row_valid_vote_reconciliation.method: Independent visual read of the four presidential candidate total cells on the same final TOTAL row.

row_reconciliation.governed_p23_registered_voters_source: KDA-VOTERS-CON-027-2022 (data/indicators/registry/observations.json), exact sum of official IEBC child ward rows

note: Total Valid Votes, Rejected Ballots and the four candidate cells are individually clear and internally reconcile on the printed TOTAL row (candidate sum 25,086 = printed Total Valid Votes). However, the row's own printed Registered Voters figure (53,293) does not exactly match the separately governed P23 registered-voter denominator for this constituency (53,253). The printed Form 34B total includes one special-facility polling station with a non-ward code ('049292145101801 GARISSA MAIN - 01', registered 40 -- exactly the observed delta), which is outside the ordinary ward-boundary polling-station set used to derive the governed ward-summed registered-voters denominator. This matches the recurring genuine prison/national-facility denominator gap documented elsewhere in this Atlas (e.g. Baringo Central, Matuga, Lamu West) rather than a transcription error. Per the extraction contract's exact-reconciliation requirement for registered_voters (mismatch_treatment: unresolved), this row is preserved unresolved and no turnout observation may be promoted from this evidence until the denominator conflict is independently reconciled by the governed P23 registered-voters denominator process.
